arguments.content:
-- Migration: add and backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping generated from codes.csv:
-- A = gold, B = silver, C = bronze

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

arguments.command:
set -eu
rm -f /tmp/loyalty-migration-test.db
if command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sqlite3 /tmp/loyalty-migration-test.db < schema.sql
  sqlite3 /tmp/loyalty-migration-test.db < migrate.sql
  sqlite3 -header -column /tmp/loyalty-migration-test.db 'SELECT id, legacy_code, loyalty FROM customers ORDER BY id;'
else
  python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/loyalty-migration-test.db')
for path in ('schema.sql', 'migrate.sql'):
    with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        con.executescript(f.read())
for row in con.execute('SELECT id, legacy_code, loyalty FROM customers ORDER BY id'):
    print('|'.join(map(str, row)))
con.close()
PY
fi
./run-migration.sh
printf '\nMigration runner log:\n'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
